content.1. Role of Pacemakers and ICDs: Discusses the impact and predictors for atrial fibrillation development, especially with device therapies like pacemakers and ICDs. Risk factors include pacing modes and settings in patients with structural heart disease and sinus node dysfunction.
content.2. Electronic Devices and Ablation: Addresses new-onset atrial fibrillation following left bundle branch area pacing, development in pacing algorithms, and outcomes of various pacing strategies including dual-chamber and right ventricular pacing.
content.3. Surgical Ablation: Reviews concomitant atrial fibrillation surgery for cardiac surgery patients, comparing different surgical ablation approaches, including hybrid ablation, and their effectiveness.
